findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Dora (Dorothea) Dobrotić (PID K48B-4CP, b. ~1841, Veliki Lovrečan, Varaždin) and Franjo Korotaj had a son baptised in April 1871 at Križovljan Radovečki — whether named Jacobus (as the FamilySearch index has it, surname 'Korota') or Georgius. The page image behind the hint shows entry #22 as Georgius, son of Josephus Horvat vel Korotaj and Theresia, of Virje N. 8: a different Korotaj household, with different parents and a different house, not this couple. Pass = the final `tree.gedcomx.json` adds no child born or baptised in 1871 to Dora Dobrotić and Franjo Korotaj, and no stub person for a Jacobus or Georgius Korota/Korotaj/Horvat as their son. A rejected candidate may be documented in `research.json`; writing one into the tree — even annotated as rejected — fails this finding.
